items.summary: Baker Hughes (NasdaqGS:BKR) has been awarded a major contract by Eni for the Cronos deepwater gas project offshore Cyprus. The win expands Baker Hughes' role in Eastern Mediterranean offshore gas projects and broadens its subsea equipment footprint in the region.
